CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.measured: ALL THIRTEEN CHECKBOXES ON THIS FOUR-PAGE SWORN PETITION ARE DISPLACED FROM THE POSITIONS THE COURT'S FORM PUTS THEM IN, AND TEN OF THE THIRTEEN LAND ON TOP OF PRINTED OFFICIAL TEXT. Root cause read out of the delivered file, not inferred: the flattener emits each widget appearance as a form XObject placed with '1 0 0 1 <rect.x> <rect.y> cm'. The 19 text-field XObjects carry origin-anchored bounding boxes (BBox [0 0 466.2 16.08], body '1 0 466.2 16.08 re W* n ...') and land correctly. The 13 checkbox XObjects carry ABSOLUTE-PAGE-COORDINATE bounding boxes and draw at absolute coordinates - e.g. /FlatWidget-2867949010 BBox [147.916 412.342 159.436 423.862], body '/G0 gs 0 G 1 g 1 w 148.416 412.842 10.52 10.52 re B*' - so the translate is applied a second time on top of coordinates that already carry it. Every checkbox is offset by its own rect origin. What this looks like on the delivered page, read from pdftoppm -png -r 110 renders of every page of canonical.pdf and compared against the same render of the pinned source: PAGE 1 - the four eligibility-recital boxes (SingleFelonyCB, MultipleFelonyCB, SingleSatisfiedCB, MultilpleSatisfiedCB, source rects all at x91.68) are gone from the left margin beside their recitals, and four empty squares are stamped instead at x~301pt over the petitioner's name line beside 'Casey Lorraine Whitmore', over the form's own bold title 'PETITION FOR EXPUNGEMENT OF FELONY VIOLATIONS' (obscuring the O of PETITION), over the CHARGE row-4 rule line, and inside the body text of the section 61-11-26 multiple-felony recital over the words 'all the charges'. PAGE 2 - the four order-election boxes are gone from beside their Yes/No labels in item i; three empty squares are stamped instead over the SECOND ANSWER LINE OF ITEM D, inside the answer area of ITEM E, and a fourth is clipped by the top edge of the page. PAGE 3 - the two prior-expungement boxes beside item m's Yes/No are pushed entirely off the page and do not appear at all. PAGE 4 - the three delivery-method boxes are gone from beside 'First Class Mail', 'Hand Delivery' and 'Certified Mail - Return Receipt'; three empty squares are stamped instead over the address area of certificate recipient 4, over the printed text of recipient 5 ('disposed of the Petitioner's'), and on recipient 6's rule line. A NARROW INACCURACY IN THE PARTICIPANT GUIDE, not scored as an obligation failure. participant-instructions.md line 27 says of the petition component that 'every fact about the conviction, every eligibility recital, and all of pages 3 and 4 are yours'. All of page 4 is indeed the participant's, but page 3 is not entirely: the build writes the participant's legal name on the verification's own 'I, ____' line at p3 x94.9-219.6 y403.1-413.2. The same document discloses that fill correctly twice elsewhere - line 9 ('The platform filled in your name...') and the 'Things the platform deliberately left blank' section, which scopes page 3 accurately to 'Your signature on page 2, the verification signature and date on page 3, and the notarial block'. The write itself is correct and is the right call (build-findings records that without it the verification would go to a notary with no name in it). Recorded because on a sworn instrument an over-broad 'all of page 3 is yours' could lead a participant not to read what is already printed above their oath.

THE FLATTENING FAULT IS NOT SPECIFIC TO WEST VIRGINIA AND WILL REPEAT. The cause is generic: any source form whose checkbox appearance streams carry absolute-page-coordinate BBoxes will be double-offset by a flattener that places the XObject with a translate by the widget rect origin. It is invisible to all nine counters, invisible to text extraction (the strays are vector rects, not glyphs), and invisible to the raster gate (the pages still render, are non-blank and are cropped to the paper). Every official_pdf_fill family that flattens an AcroForm should be re-read at the raster for displaced checkboxes, and the fix belongs in the shared finalizer rather than in this family.

theArticle988Question.result: THE PACKET AND ITS INSTRUCTIONS NOW AGREE. Every other mention of Article 988 in the delivered packet was checked in context (14 occurrences): all are either the record's requirement stated correctly, the conditional phrasing 'any Article 988 fee exemption', the fee-exemption route under Article 983(F), or the Article 986 list of statutory forms.
